instruction_page.title: Speech Evaluation Task
paragraphs: In this survey, you will listen to pairs of speech recordings in your own voice.
For each question, you will compare two speech recordings and rate how similar the voice identity and accent are between the recordings.
You will also annotate any specific clues in the sentence that helped you make your decision about the accent similarity rating.
Please follow the instructions and listen to both speech recordings in full before making any choices.
instruction_page.notice: You should listen to the audio with headphones and in a quiet environment, so you can hear the recordings as clearly as possible.
instruction_page.question_count: There will be {question_count} questions in total.

demonstration_page.title: Annotation Demonstration
paragraphs: Before beginning the evaluation, practise identifying accent clues using the two examples below.

Listen to both recordings in each example, then select only the specific sentence segments that helped you hear an accent difference. These practice responses will not count as experimental questions.
demonstration_page.answer_message: The example answer segments are outlined in green. Compare them with your selections, then continue to the evaluation.

final_feedback_page.title: Final Task Feedback
final_feedback_page.introduction: Please answer all three questions before submitting your responses.

similarity_difficulty.title: How difficult were the speaker and accent similarity rating tasks?
similarity_difficulty.instruction: Rate the overall difficulty from 1 (very easy) to 5 (very difficult).

annotation_difficulty.title: How difficult was the accent clue annotation task?
annotation_difficulty.instruction: Rate the overall difficulty from 1 (very easy) to 5 (very difficult).

comments.title: Do you have any other comments about the tasks?
comments.instruction: Please comment on anything that affected your ratings or annotations. If you have no additional comments, enter ‘No additional comments’.

question_page.title: Speaker and Accent Similarity
question_page.introduction: Listen carefully to both recordings in full, then answer all questions below.
question_page.missing_reference_audio: Reference audio is not yet available for {utterance_id}.
question_page.missing_candidate_audio: Candidate audio is not yet available for {utterance_id}.

speaker_rating.title: Q1. How similar are the speaker identities?
speaker_rating.instruction: Rate how similar the speaker identities in the two recordings are on a scale from 1 (completely different speakers) to 5 (identical speakers). Please disregard differences in accent characteristics, naturalness, or audio quality.

accent_rating.title: Q2. How similar are the accents?
accent_rating.instruction: Rate how similar the accents in the two recordings are on a scale from 1 (completely different accents) to 5 (identical accents). Please disregard differences in voice characteristics, naturalness, or audio quality.

annotation.title: Q3. Perceived Accent Clues Annotation
paragraphs: Highlight only the specific parts of the sentence or word that helped you identify accent differences. For example, select only ter in water if that part made the accents sound different.
You may annotate perceived differences even if you rated the accents as identical. Leave all parts unselected only if you perceive no accent difference.
